marks.gloss_en: R' Yitzchak's parable: a hungry, tired, thirsty traveller in the desert finds a tree with sweet fruit, pleasant shade and a stream beneath; leaving, he says: with what shall I bless you? -- may all saplings planted from you be like you
ת"ל מלקוש, מה מלקוש לברכה אף יורה לברכה -- the two rains named together (Deut 11:14): as malkosh is for a blessing, so is yoreh
ת"ל יורה, מה יורה לברכה אף מלקוש לברכה -- the mirror hekesh: as yoreh is for a blessing, so is malkosh
or perhaps yoreh means that it makes the fruit drop, washes away the seeds and washes away the trees
ויורה גופיה מנלן? דכתיב כי נתן לכם את המורה לצדקה (Joel 2:23) -- the hekesh's source side, yoreh's blessing, from its own verse
and yoreh itself, whence [that it is for a blessing]? 'for He has given you the first rain (moreh) in kindness (litzdaka)' (Joel 2:23)
yoreh: it instructs people to plaster their roofs, bring in their produce, and see to all their needs
בעתו יורה ומלקוש -- מה מלקוש בעתו אף יורה בעתו: as the malkosh comes in its time [Nisan], so the yoreh in its time [Marcheshvan, not Kislev]
Marcheshvan, or perhaps Kislev? 'in its time, yoreh and malkosh': as the malkosh is in its time, so the yoreh is in its time
דתניא: ... רבי יוסי אומר: בשבעה עשר ובעשרים ושלשה ובראש חדש כסליו -- R' Yosei's latest date is Kislev, as the Sages' (kind tanya_kevatei for דתניא, under protest)
who are the Sages? Rav Chisda: it is R' Yosei
כמאן -- כרבי יוסי: the identification rests on R' Yosei's dates (the seven-day spacing is Steinsaltz's explanation)
RSBG: rains that fell seven days one after another -- you count in them the first and second, [or second and] third rainfall
דתנן: הנודר עד הגשמים -- משירדו גשמים עד שתרד רביעה שניה
granted: the first rainfall -- for asking [for rain]; the third -- for fasting
the first rain (yoreh) is in Marcheshvan
malkosh: a thing that circumcises the stubbornness of Israel
R' Meir: yoreh in Marcheshvan and malkosh in Nisan
R' Yosei: on the 17th, the 23rd, and Rosh Chodesh Kislev
Rav Chisda: the halakha follows R' Yosei
